title: Handwriting
transcript:
Night. The tool room, lit only by the green of the exit sign.
No pen. He bites the side of his finger until it opens.

The letters come out brown and shaking.
YOU'VE BEEN HERE BEFORE.

He stops. Listens for boots on the spine. Writes faster.
DON'T TRUST THE VOICE. POOL. HOLD YOUR BREATH.

PARTH:
"Next time you'll read this. Next time you'll know."

He folds it twice and leaves it where only the code can reach.
He won't remember the code either. He is counting on his hands to.
